candidates.change_summary: Remove the assignment to betLimit so AdjustBetAmounts no longer updates the bet limit.
Change the assignment so betLimit is set to amount + 1 instead of amount.
Set betLimit to 0 regardless of the amount passed in.
Remove the onlyOwner require so any caller can invoke AdjustBetAmounts and change betLimit.
Invert the ownership check so only non-owners pass the modifier, allowing anyone except the owner to change betLimit.
Replace the assignment `difficulty = amount;` with `betLimit = amount;`, so difficulty is never updated and betLimit is corrupted instead.
Delete the statement `difficulty = amount;` so calls to AdjustDifficulty no longer change the difficulty state variable.
Replace `difficulty = amount;` with `difficulty = betLimit;` so difficulty is set to the current bet limit instead of the passed amount.
Delete the `require(msg.sender == owner);` check in onlyOwner so any address can call AdjustDifficulty and change difficulty.
Invert the ownership check to `require(msg.sender != owner);` so the owner can no longer call AdjustDifficulty while others can.
Set openToPublic to false instead of true, so the contract never opens to the public.
Delete the assignment so openToPublic remains false after the call.
Toggle openToPublic instead of setting it to true, so repeated calls flip it off.
Invert the ownership check so onlyOwner reverts for the owner, meaning OpenToThePublic always reverts and openToPublic stays false.
Remove the require so anyone can call OpenToThePublic, letting non-owners set openToPublic to true.
